title: Austin Aries invents Option C
summary: Austin Aries refuses to treat the X Division championship as a ceiling. He negotiates a route to a world-title match and risks his existing belt to challenge Bobby Roode.

chapters.title: Aries proposes a third option
chapters.result: Aries proposes surrendering the X Division title for a world-title opportunity.
chapters.context: He asks Hogan to make the choice available to future X Division champions at Destination X, turning a personal opportunity into a recurring path upward.

chapters.title: Option C pays off
chapters.result: Austin Aries defeats Bobby Roode to win the TNA world championship.
chapters.context: The gamble succeeds as Aries ends Roode’s long reign and demonstrates the stakes of surrendering one championship to pursue another.
